scalars.scalar_value: EXPERIENCE: Three years of responsible accounting or general clerical experience, including areas of maintenance, purchasing, and personnel. EDUCATION: College courses from an accredited institution in business or related education may be substituted for two years of the required experience on a year-for-year basis. Have an equity-minded focus, responsiveness, and sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, including those with physical or learning disabilities as it relates to differences in learning styles; and successfully foster and support an inclusive educational and employment environment. Promotional : One year of experience with LRCCD as a Maintenance Operations Clerk or equivalent, including responsibility for maintenance, payroll and purchase order processing and procedures. (Promotional applies to current, regular Classified employees working with the Los Rios Community College District.) ( Experience Requirement : One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Education Requirement: One year of education is equal to 30 semester units.) Education must be from an accredited institution.

items.item_text: 01. Please indicate how you meet the education minimum qualifications for the Operations Technician position by selecting the option that best describes your qualifications. NOTE: Experience Requirement: One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Experience used to meet the minimum qualifications must be clearly stated in the application. Missing information may result in the experience not being counted. Options: I have three (3) or more years of responsible accounting or general clerical experience. | I have two (2) or more years of responsible accounting or general clerical experience AND one (1) or more years of college courses from an accredited institution in business or related education. | I have one (1) or more years of responsible accounting or general clerical experience AND two (2) or more years of college courses from an accredited institution in business or related education. | I do not meet the minimum qualifications.
